text:
leo-ops: Kicking off SEA-2 private cluster bootstrap for MeridianCorp. Scope: VPC-only, fully air-gapped image mirror, reserved 8x A10G nodepool. This thread for network preflight, image delivery, and handoff.

sam-delivery: Quick note on customer constraints: no outbound egress except to their allowed seed IPs; they require IPSec to their gateway, MTU 1500 enforced, and no package downloads from nodes during install.

mira-infra: They also require HSM-backed KMS and weekly cert rotation. We must pin image digests and deliver offline registry on encrypted media.

anya-sre: Proposed minimal preflight checklist (rough):
- confirm seed VM SSH from our handoff host
- establish IPSec tunnel and validate SA lifetime
- populate offline registry + verify manifests and digests
- ensure kubelet MTU/ip-forward settings match customer network
- preload GPU driver + container runtime + kernel headers
- smoke-run 10 concurrent inference requests against pinned model

leo-ops: I'll take seed provisioning + IPSec. @mira-infra you own registry mirror + signing. @anya-sre you'll run validation + perf. @sam-delivery coordinate courier pickup for media.

sam-delivery: Courier ETA for encrypted USBs is 2026-03-21 16:00 local. Will label devices USB-SEA2-A/B and include checksum.txt.asc signed by customer.

mira-infra: Mirror artifact list to bring: runtime tarball (redwood-runtime-1.3.0.tar.gz), model bundle (meridian-model-v2.sq), nvidia-driver-debs, containerd & runc pkgs. Mirror command (run on airgap host):
```
./mirror.sh --artifacts redwood-runtime-1.3.0.tar.gz meridian-model-v2.sq --dest /var/registry --digest-file checksums.txt
```

anya-sre: Validation commands I'll run (examples):
```
# seed reachability
ssh -o BatchMode=yes redwood@<seed-ip> 'uname -a'
# IPSec state
sudo ip xfrm state list
# MTU path check
ping -M do -s 1400 <node-ip>
# kubelet registration
kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep sea2
# GPU probe
nvidia-smi -L; docker run --gpus all redwood/runtime:smoke ./bench --concurrency 10
```

devops-bot: Scheduled: SEA-2-seed-bootstrap -> 2026-03-22T03:00Z by leo-ops. Auto-rollback on seed failure.

finance-paul: Flag: reserved 8x A10G for 12 months needs finance signoff. Preliminary cost estimate attached in internal sheet: https://internal.redwood/fin/sea2-est. Please confirm before committing. If customer wants burst capacity, we need approval for 2x burst hosts.

leo-ops: Rack/power check: customer rack manifest shows 12A headroom, okay for 8xA10G nodes. Delivery note: ensure PDUs mapped and labelled.

sam-delivery: Delivery requirements from customer: USBs must be scanned and checksums verified in front of their infra lead, chain-of-custody form signed.

mira-infra: Also: container image manifests must be pinned with sha256 and OIDC issuer for service account configured to customer ID. We'll generate service account JSON on seed and verify tokens do not leave airgap.

anya-sre: Perf validation plan (orders):
1) seed SSH + ports
2) IPSec SA establishment & cross-node ping
3) MTU & fragmentation stress (large packets)
4) kubelet join + taint/label checks
5) GPU probe and micro-bench (token throughput)
6) 10-concurrent inference smoke and 60-second stability window

leo-ops: Action owners and due dates:
- leo-ops: provision seed VM and configure IPSec (by 2026-03-22 03:00Z)
- mira-infra: prepare mirrored registry on USB + signed checksums (by 2026-03-21 18:00Z)
- anya-sre: run preflight + perf validation and attach logs (by 2026-03-22 05:00Z)
- sam-delivery: courier drop + chain-of-custody (by 2026-03-21 16:00 local)
- finance-paul: cost approval for reserved capacity (by 2026-03-20 EOD)

sam-delivery: I'll post pickup confirmation and tracking here when done.

leo-ops: infra-ci-bot, create checklist for SEA-2 airgap preflight please.

infra-ci-bot: Preflight checklist created: SEA2-airgap-preflight-287630001. Link: https://internal.redwood/infra/checklists/287630001

mira-infra: Reminder: bring spare USB with full image set in case of corruption. Also bring signed MD5 and SHA256 lists. Customer insists on MD5 as well.

anya-sre: I'll attach perf logs and a short runbook snippet after validation. Keep this thread for status updates during the window. React with :white_check_mark: when you complete your item.

leo-ops: Closing initial kickoff. Will reopen if blockers. Thanks all.
